actual_primary_read.method: Re-read entire primary INTERVAL abstract in previously live-fetched Europe PMC core record; no full text or iron-recovery-specific study newly read.
actual_primary_read.exact_quote: Over 2 years, more frequent donation than is standard practice in the UK collected substantially more blood without having a major effect on donors' quality of life, physical activity, or cognitive function, but resulted in more donation-related symptoms, deferrals, and iron deficiency.
actual_primary_read.scope: Adults aged 18 years or older; UK donor-frequency comparison over 2 years. This abstract does not establish a universal iron recovery time after a donation.
actual_primary_read.limitation: 건강 상태·철 보충 여부에 따른 회복기간은 확인하지 않았고 독자본문에 기간을 제시하지 않습니다.
